description: Search event-type CFTC product filings in the MORVS Prediction Market Register by exchange code/name, listed year, filing status, MORVS topic, CFTC stay remark or public title substring. The default year is the latest published listed-year shard. A Certified filing was self-certified by the exchange under CFTC rule 40.2; it was not approved by the CFTC. Approval Pending and Approved are a separate product-approval route. Filings are not markets, volume, users or odds. Dates are as listed by the CFTC and can be re-dated after a status change. Topics are MORVS classification. Titles that may name individuals are withheld and are never searched; use the CFTC ID link for the source record. A stay is not a finding of a violation.

exchange.description: Optional DCM code or case-insensitive exchange name substring.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive title substring, at most 80 characters; withheld titles are never searched.

stayed.description: If supplied, filter filings by whether a CFTC stay is recorded; a stay is not a finding.

year.description: CFTC listed year; defaults to the latest published filings shard. Listed dates can re-date.

name: prediction_market_filings
